Update outdated root IDs

octo_latestid.Rd

Finds the current root ID for each input, also for IDs that are not in the seed table (for those, octo_update_ids() is the better route because it works from the seed position). When a neuron was split, the piece holding most of a random sample of the old neuron's level-2 chunks is chosen.

Usage

octo_latestid(ids, sample = 100L, details = FALSE)

Arguments

ids

root IDs (character)

sample

number of level-2 chunks sampled for split neurons

details

return a data.frame (old_id, new_id, n_candidates, overlap) instead of a vector

Value

character vector of current IDs, or a data.frame

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
octo_latestid(c("720575940...", "720575940..."))
octo_latestid(old_ids, details = TRUE)   # check overlap for split neurons
} # }
